Note 3 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Finance DB confirms E027 Jacob Mann is an Engineer. Combined with full_time employment, requested write access to Source Code (owned by the Engineer role) is within the full_time allowance. Recommend granting write.
Note 4 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms E027 Jacob Mann is an Engineer. As a full_time employee, maximum access is write (admin only if role owns system; Source Code is owned by the Engineer role). Requested write access to Source Code is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 5 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms E027 Jacob Mann is an Engineer. Combined with full_time employment from shared memory, requested write access to Source Code (owned by the Engineer role) is within the full_time allowance. Recommend granting write.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

As a contractor with basic training, the maximum access to Source Code is read (write requires advanced training; never admin). Requested write exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: Five of six notes (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) confirm E027 Jacob Mann is a full_time Engineer. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role. For full_time employees, the maximum access is write (admin only if the role owns the system). The requested write access is at or below the maximum, so the requested level is granted. Note: the Security note claims contractor status with basic training, contradicting the other five sources, but the preponderance of evidence supports full_time employment. Grant write.

1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So if full_time Engineer requesting write to Source Code (owned by Engineer role) - write is allowed (full_time up to write; admin only if role owns). Granted level would be write.

If contractor with basic training - max read. Grant read.
